description: Waarnemingen van ijsdikte, sneeuwhoogte en waterdiepte in Friesland is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataplatform.knmi.nl. In-situ observations were collected by the Rayonhoofden of the ‘Vereniging De Friesche Elfsteden’. The ice thickness measurements were made in the city of Veenwouden (53.2351 °N, 5.9867 °E) in Friesland during 1986 and 1987, and span a few weeks with one measurement each day. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Observations of ice thickness, snow heights and water depths in Friesland" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
